test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

The radio data shows neither evidence for ongoing jet activity.
solution:
The correct answer is "**neither evidence for**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the part "neither evidence for."
 
• **The use of the conjunction "neither" is inappropriate.**
 
• **Neither allows us to make a negative statement about two people or things at the same time.**
 
 
• **But no two things are mentioned in the given statement. Thus, the use of "neither" is incorrect.**
 
 
 
• The correct word to use is "no" before the noun.
 
• The correct statement will be:
 
 
• The radio data shows no evidence for ongoing jet activity. 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
